mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not show sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as expanding demand boosts market confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive when GDPC1 shows upward trend (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.0% or 5-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates below 3.5% and rising quarterly GDP growth above 2% in the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to dual easing signals.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 3.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2% in prior month
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS ≥3.5% or GDPC1 growth ≤2% in prior month, or 20-day returns not positive (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as discount rates normalize.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS does not decline by >1% over 60 days or 60-day returns are not positive (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and downward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as demand outpaces supply.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% and INDPRO decline > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 growth ≤2% or INDPRO decline ≤1% in the same month, or 20-day returns not positive (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly paid employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 units signals labor market tightness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 150k in the next month
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 150k or 60-day returns are not positive (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of federal funds rates below 3.5% and rising demand-side index (RSAFS) above 1 million dollars predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to dual easing signals.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 3.5% and RSAFS > 1M in the same month
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS ≥3.5% or RSAFS ≤1M in the same month, or 5-day returns not positive (p >0.05).
